title: Allosterism in p53 – Can AI Solve the Puzzle?
content: Intrinsically disordered p53 is a promising target for precision oncology. p53 undergoes structural changes that induce long-chain fluctuations, known as allosterism. Allosteric shifts regulate p53 translation, stability, or transcription activity. The 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry recognises advancements in computational protein design and structure prediction through AI innovations. Yet, current AI-based tools might not be sufficient in unravelling the complexity of allosteric regulation in p53 - a knowledge essential for turning p53 into a feasible therapeutic target.
